name: anvil
description: Anvil — real-time collaborative cloud IDE and project workspace styled after VS Code

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n EMULATORS,BACKEND,FRONTEND -c yellow,cyan,green "npm run emulators" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:app: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c cyan,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --workspace=backend run build && npm --workspace=frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=backend run typecheck && npm --workspace=frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace=backend run test && npm --workspace=frontend run test
scripts.test:e2e: cross-env USE_FIREBASE_EMULATORS=true node scripts/run-emulators.mjs exec --only auth,storage,dataconnect "npm --workspace=backend run test:e2e"
